summary: Monthly CSV of new USDOT numbers / operating authority granted by FMCSA, sliced by state and cargo type. Freshly registered carriers are the highest-value leads for commercial trucking insurance agents, factoring companies, ELD mandate vendors, and freight dispatch services. The full FMCSA Company Census is public and updated daily; the gap is a cheap, filterable one-time download of only the newest entries.

audience.who: Commercial trucking insurance agents, freight factoring companies, ELD hardware/software vendors, and owner-operator dispatch services that need to reach newly authorized carriers within their first 60 days of operation.

data_wanted: USDOT number, carrier name, physical address, phone, email (where public), MC/FF authority type, cargo carried, fleet size, state of domicile, date authority granted — sourced from FMCSA Company Census and Licensing & Insurance public search.

evidence.source: Fiverr listing — active seller at $50 per 1,000 fresh FMCSA leads
evidence.quote: provide 1000 fresh trucking leads from fmcsa database for $50

willingness_to_pay.signal: Fiverr sellers charge $50 per 1,000 leads; USTruckingCompanies charges $399 for the full DB. Insurance and factoring reps pay $15-100 per qualified new-carrier lead from traditional brokers. A niche monthly slice (e.g., new Texas carriers last 30 days) priced at $29-49 one-time sits well below all incumbent pricing.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/Truckers, r/FreightBrokers, r/Insurance
first_sale_path.angle: "New FMCSA Carriers — [State] [Month] 2026" — monthly snapshot of every carrier that received operating authority in the last 30 days, filtered by state, formatted CSV. Positioned as a cheap alternative to $399 full-DB or $50/1,000 Fiverr gigs, with the freshness advantage none of those offer.
